Name: Not Gothic Abigail
Author: BenjuaG050
Description:
[left][b]Hi everyone! 👋 This is my first mod, and I hope you’ll like it! 
==================================================================================================

  This mod is meant to make Abigail not a fan of mysticism and goth culture, but just an ordinary girl. Yes, someone might say, “What’s the point of this mod if it kills her character and unique interests?” I don’t know, but maybe in the future I’ll create a new storyline for Abigail. At least, I’d like to — but I can’t say how soon it’ll be done, or whether it’ll happen at all.
  I made this mod simply because I’ve always wanted to see Abigail in natural colors.

What the mod currently does:
1. Replaces Abigail’s original [b]sprites and portraits[/b] with a different color palette and slight modifications.
2. Replaces Abigail’s original [b]winter sprites and portraits[/b] with a different color palette and slight modifications.
3. Replaces Abigail’s original [b]beach sprites and portraits[/b] with a different color palette.
4. Replaces the colors of Abigail’s portrait sold by the Traveling Merchant, which can be purchased after marrying Abigail.

==================================================================================================


-----------------------------------------------
[color=#e06666]Requirements[/color] for installing the mod:

1. SMAPI version 4.0.0 or newer
2. Content Patcher version 2.8.0 or newer
-----------------------------------------------

-----------------------------------------------
Installation 💻

a) [color=#ff7700]Manual installation:[/color]
1. Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Stardew Modding Application Programming Interface[/url]﻿ (SMAPI)[/b] version 4.0.0 or higher.
👇You can find the manual installation guide for SMAPI here 👇
[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows
[/url]2. Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/b] version 2.8.0 or higher by unpacking it into the [b]Mods[/b] folder in your game’s root directory after installing SMAPI.
3. Download the mod [b]“Not Gothic Abigail.”
[/b]4. Unpack the archive and place its contents into the [b]Mods[/b] folder in your game’s root directory. For example, if you have the Steam version, it should be located at ...\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\
5. Done! ✅ Launch the game through [b][color=#93c47d]StardewModdingAPI.exe[/color][/b] located in the game’s root folder.
6. If you see [color=#e06666]red lines[/color] in the console, something was installed incorrectly or your dependency versions don’t match the required ones.

b) [color=#ff7700]Installation via Nexus Mods App:[/color]
1. Open the application.
2. Create a profile for [b]Stardew Valley[/b] mods if you don’t already have one.
3. Click [b]“Add ➕”  → “From Disk” or "From Nexsus Mods"
[/b]4.In the window that opens, find the [b]SMAPI archive | [/b]⚠️when using the app, you must install it this way! ⚠️ | and double-click it, then click [b]“Install”[/b] on the right side.
5. Do the same with [b]Content Patcher[/b] and the [b]Not Gothic Abigail[/b] mod.
Done! ✅ Click [b]“Apply”[/b], then [b]“Play.”
[/b]6. If you see [color=#e06666]red lines[/color] in the console, something was installed incorrectly or your dependency versions don’t match the required ones.
-----------------------------------------------

                     
                                                                                                [size=5]❓Frequently Asked Questions:[/size][/b][/left]
[center][b][color=#9fc5e8]1. Will the mod be updated?[/color]
✅The mod will continue to be updated until it’s fully polished.
[color=#9fc5e8]2. Is the mod compatible with Seasonal Outfits – Slightly Cuter Aesthetic?[/color]
❌No. Seasonal Outfits – Slightly Cuter Aesthetic replaces the vanilla portraits with its own, and this mod does the same. They will not work together.
[color=#9fc5e8]3. Is the mod compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded or Ridgeside Village?[/color]
Most likely yes, since I don’t recall those mods adding their own portraits or sprites for Abigail.
[color=#9fc5e8]4. Is the mod compatible with event expansion mods?[/color]
Only if those mods don’t add their own sprites or portraits and instead use the vanilla ones.
[color=#9fc5e8]5. Can I make a compatibility patch for your mod with another mod?[/color]
Please contact me first in the comments or on Discord 👉 [b]benjuavelikiy[/b] 👈 so we can discuss the details.
[color=#9fc5e8]6. Can I create a translation of your mod?[/color]
✅Yes, you can, as long as it’s not a machine translation.
[color=#e06666]Note:[/color] Russian and Ukrainian translations are already included in the mod.

==================================================================================================

[font=Courier New][size=4]📋Planned Features in Future Updates:[/size]

[/font][s]1. Fix issue #1 from the “Known Issues” list.[/s]✅
[s]2. Replace all dialogues related to Abigail’s original appearance with ones matching the mod[/s].✅
[s]3. Redesign the painting sold by the Traveling Merchant[/s].✅
4. Modify all storyline events with Abigail that involve mysticism (possibly).
